notes: 02: title is synthesized from the URL slug (deriveTitle), not collected from the target page; description/favicon/preview are never fetched or stored. 03: no title/description fields exist to edit. 04: only tag("group") editing exists (makeEditor); url/title/description/note editing is absent. 06: duplicate save is blocked and the existing card is highlighted (flashId), but there is no edit-existing flow to converge into since url/title/description editing doesn't exist. 07: list shows title/url/tags only, no description or favicon. 12: search() only scans title/url/groups — no description or note fields exist. 14: search() does plain substring matching; no '#tag' parsing. 15: no boolean/parenthesis/quote parsing in search(). 16: no phrase/quote handling. 17-19: no unread/read-later flag anywhere in the data model. 20-21: no multi-select or bulk-action UI/logic. 22: list is hardcoded newest-first with no sort control. 23: no note field. 24-25: no snapshot capture (client-only app). 26-28: no archived flag or archive view. 29: no bundle/saved-filter entity. 30-31: no import/export code. 32: no settings UI (sort/items-per-page/font size).
